summary: This project focuses on the design and implementation of a 50 kg/hr electric induction boiler system to replace the existing LDO-fired boiler at Attach Industries. The solution delivers high-efficiency steam generation using a fully electric heating approach integrated with PLC-based automation and safety controls. The system is engineered to improve operational efficiency, reduce fuel dependency, and ensure stable industrial steam output.

challenge.description: Attach Industries required a transition from a conventional LDO-based boiler system to a modern electric induction boiler to improve energy efficiency, safety, and environmental compliance. The existing setup had limitations in fuel dependency, operational consistency, and real-time process control. Additionally, there was a need to integrate advanced automation, including PLC-based monitoring, PID control, and multi-sensor safety systems, to ensure reliable steam generation at industrial standards.

methodology.title: System Design & Engineering
methodology.description: Detailed electrical and thermal design of the induction boiler system, including coil configuration, load calculations, wiring schematics, and selection of control components compatible with industrial requirements.

methodology.title: Automation & Control Integration
methodology.description: Development and integration of PLC-based control architecture with PID loops for temperature, pressure, and flow regulation. Integration of sensors, VFD-controlled pumps, and safety interlocks.

methodology.title: Testing & Commissioning Support
methodology.description: On-site implementation support, system testing, calibration of sensors, validation of control logic, and optimization of operational parameters for stable and efficient boiler performance.

impact.label: THERMAL EFFICIENCY
impact.description: Achieved through direct electric induction heating with minimized thermal losses and optimized coil energy distribution.

impact.label: AUTOMATED MONITORING
impact.description: Continuous real-time monitoring of temperature, pressure, flow, and water level using PLC-integrated sensors and alarms.

impact.label: DRY RUN INCIDENTS
impact.description: Prevented through water level sensors, interlock systems, and automated shutdown logic embedded in the PLC control system.
